sources.locator: page index 0: title block 'LTEM NO.:PJ-324M (L17.70xW11.50xH6.30mm 3.5-PHONE-JACK)', Technical parameter table, top/front/side views, 5/3POLE PLUG symbol, DECIMALS/ANGLES tolerance block; page index 1: Operating Force, Solder-ability, CIRCUIT BOARD SIZE (Vertical view), empty 'Pin Definition' heading, Material declaration table
sources.evidence_extract: SOFNG-branded drawing (www.Sofng.com; SOFNG ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY Co., LTD). Dimensions in mm: front view body width 11.5, axis-to-edge 5.4, body height 6, terminal projection 3.2, bore 3.6 dia; side view body 14.2, barrel 3.5, thread M6x0.5, rear terminal row 13 from body front, front terminal 1.6; footprint 13 / 5.6 / 1.6 / 8.6 / 9.6 along axis and 4 / 2.5 / 5.2 / 4.5 across. Tolerance block .X +/-0.20, .XX +/-0.10, .XXX +/-0.05. Contact rating 50mA 24V DC; storage temp -25..+75 C with the operating-temperature field left blank; manual soldering 350 C 3 s; operating force inward/exiting 5.0-10.0 N.

sources.authority_note: SOFNG-branded drawing served by the LCSC datasheet host (datasheet.lcsc.com), so it is a distributor-hosted mirror of the manufacturer document and lower-authority than a manufacturer-hosted copy. No SOFNG-hosted copy was obtained (see src-a7-pj-324m-sofng-site). Facts read from it stay UNVERIFIED / UNSOURCED with their values retained.

No SOFNG-hosted copy of the drawing was received, so no comparison with the LCSC-hosted mirror is possible.
